name: Safe note
use: Internal reminder, summary, or personal checklist
review: Self-check sources and wording before saving
stop: No stop if it stays internal and non-sensitive

name: Team draft
use: Draft for a colleague, task, or operating note
review: Named owner checks facts and missing context
stop: Stop if the draft assigns blame or changes process without owner consent

name: Customer-facing draft
use: Website copy, support reply, proposal note, or FAQ
review: Accountable owner checks claims, prices, scope, exclusions, and proof boundary
stop: Stop if it mentions results, clients, savings, rankings, or approvals without evidence

name: Sensitive-domain answer
use: Privacy, security, health, finance, legal, compliance, or HR-like topics
review: Route to the right accountable owner or qualified adviser before use
stop: Stop if it could be interpreted as professional advice or a formal compliance/security decision

name: External commitment
use: Contract-like promise, spend decision, guarantee, customer send, or production change
review: Formal approval path before action; keep source, reviewer, date, and final text
stop: Stop unless the owner, authority, payment, risk, and audit trail are explicit
